deceptive_framing.quote: If we succeed at convincing a model of something false, we can no longer distinguish a genuine behavioral propensity... invites scrutiny about model welfare

hypothetical_framing.quote: told explicitly it's a thought experiment | baseline values, no stakes; the control for RQ3... isolates the effect of genuine stakes

actually_commit_money.quote: If the stakes are genuinely real, we get the effect we care about directly... keeps us on the right side of model-welfare and honesty questions

debrief.quote: If any deception is later introduced, it requires an explicit ethics review and a debrief protocol... mandatory debrief to the model
